jobs.title: Customer Service Officer
jobs.description: Kitchen Warehouse is Australia's leading kitchenware retailer, and our Manila office is the offshore hub supporting our Australian stores and online business. As a Customer Service Representative, you are the first point of contact for our customers, helping them across email, live chat and calls. You will resolve enquiries, process returns, and coordinate with suppliers, stores and our despatch team to deliver a smooth, accurate and genuinely helpful experience for every customer. What you will do Assist customers with enquiries submitted through email, live chat and calls. Process customer returns accurately and on time. Communicate with suppliers regarding product queries and warranty claims. Communicate with stores regarding customer orders and enquiries. Review orders and advise customers of progress or action taken. Communicate with Warehouse Despatch in regard to customer orders. Liaise with and assist the Customer Service Support Officer. Liaise with Australia Post regarding delayed or missing parcels. Identify customer complaints and escalate to the Customer Service Team or Customer Service Manager as required. Follow procedures, guidelines and policies accurately to complete assigned tasks. Perform data entry across a number of platforms. Work hours and days based on the requirements of the business (for example, Sunday to Thursday between 6am and 8pm). Assist with other additional tasks as required.

jobs.title: Treasury Reporting and Analytics Manager
jobs.description: As Treasury Reporting and Analytics Manager, you will be esponsible for building and leading the Treasury Analytics and Reporting function within the Treasury Center of Excellence (CoE). The role serves as the intelligence engine of the CoE, transforming raw TMS and ERP data into actionable insights on group liquidity, FX/IR risk, debt management, and treasury performance. The role owns the Treasury Management System (TMS) reporting architecture and Power BI analytics layer, and provides decision-support to the Treasury Services Head, Treasurer, and CFO. The role also governs SLA reporting between the Treasury CoE and the Shared Treasury Operations, ensuring data integrity, forecast accuracy, and regulatory compliance across 80+ operating, pre-development, and shell entities and contribute directly to transforming energy for a better world. You will work closely with the Treasury Team to deliver results, create positive community impact, and develop your skills in a supportive, purpose-driven environment.

jobs.title: Systems Application Engineer: 1 Year Contract
jobs.description: You'll make a difference by: Providing Level 2 technical support for mission-critical applications , troubleshooting and resolving complex system issues during the maintenance and support phase in collaboration with internal technical teams and customers. Testing and validating system updates , supporting pre- and post-release testing of application, software, and firmware updates to ensure stability and performance. Communicating technical findings and progress clearly to customers , ensuring transparency on issue status, resolution timelines, and corrective actions. Monitoring system health and performance , identifying risks proactively and supporting customers in maintaining system reliability. Assessing and coordinating support ticket escalation , prioritizing and collaborating with internal teams to resolve issues based on business impact. Your defining qualities: Strong foundation in IT systems and infrastructure , with a degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Linux environments , including troubleshooting and system administration. 3–5 years of experience working with SQL and databases , with the ability to support data analysis and issue resolution. Familiarity with virtualization and infrastructure technologies , such as VMware, servers, storage, firewall, and networking environments. Experience working in a structured technical support or service environment , managing tickets within defined service levels. Customer-oriented and adaptable mindset , with strong communication skills and willingness to support after-hours or on-call when required.

Work in tandem with the Executive Producer to align production coverage and live multimedia needs. Coordinate with the Marketing and Accounts Teams for partner requirements, branding placements, and deliverables. Maintain clear communication with sponsors, suppliers, and stakeholders before, during, and after each event. Conduct post-event partner evaluations and recommend ways to strengthen partnerships.
